seo.title: Wedding Invitation Maker – Printable 5×7 Invitations
seo.description: Create a printable wedding invitation with your names, date and venue. Download a 5×7 in print-ready PDF with bleed and a version to share by text or email.
intro: Type your names, date and venue, pick a style, and PiCraft designs a complete 5×7 inch wedding invitation with your details already typeset.
Download a print-ready PDF with bleed for your local print shop, or a phone-sized image to send by text, WhatsApp or email.

prompt:
Design a printable wedding invitation card in portrait orientation, shown flat and front-on, filling the entire image edge to edge. It is the artwork itself, not a mockup: no table, no envelope, no hands, no drop shadow.
Style: {{style}}.
The card contains exactly the following text and nothing else, each item on its own line, spelled exactly as written:
"Together with their families"
"{{names}}"
"request the pleasure of your company at their wedding"
"{{date}}"
[["{{time}}"]]
"{{venue}}"
[["{{location}}"]]
[["{{rsvp}}"]]
All text perfectly legible and well inside the card, with margins of at least 8% on every side so nothing is trimmed when printed. Balanced, centered layout, print-quality detail.

outputs.label: Print PDF 5×7 in with 0.125 in bleed
Print JPG 5×7 in with bleed, 300 DPI

faq.q: Is the text always spelled correctly?
faq.a: PiCraft uses a model that renders text accurately, but always proofread names, dates and times before printing. If something is off, generate again; each attempt is a fresh design.
Any local print shop or online printer that accepts PDF. Tell them the finished size is 5×7 in with a 0.125 in bleed.

faq.q: Can I make matching RSVP cards?
faq.a: Generate an RSVP design with the same style option and your RSVP wording in the RSVP line. Styles are consistent but not identical between generations.
Yes. The 1080×1500 share image is sized for text messages, WhatsApp, email and Instagram stories.

faq.q: Can I change the wording of the invitation?
faq.a: The top and middle lines use a traditional wording in English. Use the RSVP field for extra words, or edit the downloaded design in an image editor.
A 5×7 inch card fits an A7 envelope, which measures 5¼×7¼ inches.

faq.q: Can I add a photo of the couple?
faq.a: No. The invitations are illustrated artwork, which keeps the text layout reliable.

faq.q: What paper should I print on?
faq.a: Heavy card stock, 110 lb (300 gsm) or more, gives a premium feel. Ask your printer to show you samples before you order.
Digital invitations often go out two to three months ahead. Printed invitations commonly go out six to eight weeks before the wedding, and earlier for destination weddings.
